subject.callable: direct Triton float32 to bfloat16 RTNE conversion
subject.boundary: one launch with four Triton programs covering one contiguous 1024-element tensor

program_reference.basis: The public task is exactly the only floating operation in the launch: an explicit float32-to-bfloat16 RTNE conversion. Its declared rounding belongs in both the program value and the task value.

tasks.task_statement: Convert every received finite float32 value to bfloat16 using IEEE roundTiesToEven and preserve the full shape.

input_map.basis: the wrapper output allocation and explicit Triton cast target are bfloat16
